entity: Mayor of the City of Buffalo
stance_basis: requested formation of Joint Executive Committee to unite community support for rapid transit
summary: The Mayor of the City of Buffalo, together with the Erie County Executive, requested in May 1975 the formation of the Joint Executive Committee for Rapid Transit, an action described as aimed at uniting community groups in demonstrating support for rapid transit. This single mention portrays the Mayor as an active proponent of the mass transit project. No complaint or opposition is attributed to the Mayor in this window.
complaint_summary: The Mayor of the City of Buffalo, along with the Erie County Executive, requested the formation of the Joint Executive Committee for Rapid Transit in May 1975 to unite community groups in support of rapid transit.
summary_quote: In May 1975, at the request of the Erie County Executive and the Mayor of the City of Buffalo, the Joint Executive Committee for Rapid Transit was formed.
